title: Five Flows free VRAM before their output (MpiClearVram)
description: LTX Foley, LTX Extend, Pano360, Transcribe and Voice Changer had no MpiClearVram, so their models stayed resident after a run. Add one MpiClearVram passthrough just before each output node (Fabio, 2026-10-28), in raw/ and resynced.
